turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a, an and the?
turns.tutor:
Sure. Here is my thinking on one example.
This is ___ island. "Island" starts with the sound "i" (like "eye"). That is a vowel sound, so: This is an island.
The rule: "an" before a vowel sound; "a" before a consonant sound.
Right: This is a river. Wrong: This is an river.
Now try it. Write a or an: She has ___ orange in her bag. (answer with only the missing word)
